annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in China

description: The gross yearly salary in China that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

bonus_separate.description: Tax the year-end bonus separately. Uses the bonus amount field above. Separate taxation is usually cheaper at moderate incomes. Default true.

city.description: City: shanghai = Shanghai; beijing = Beijing; shenzhen = Shenzhen; guangzhou = Guangzhou. Default shanghai.

elderly.description: Supporting parents aged 60+: none = No; only = Yes, only child (¥3,000/month); shared = Yes, shared with siblings (¥1,500/month). Default none.

expat_allowances.description: Tax-free expat allowances. Foreign nationals: housing, language training and children's school fees paid against receipts. (¥ / year). Default 0.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many CNY, for the euro amounts. Default 7.6 (indicative).

housing_ded.description: Housing deduction: none = None; tier1 = Rent, tier-1 city (¥1,500/month); tier2 = Rent, large city (¥1,100/month); tier3 = Rent, other city (¥800/month); mortgage = First-home mortgage interest (¥1,000/month). Default none.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.
